metadata.title: Message Queuing

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing reliable asynchronous message delivery while constraining operational and security risks.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Message brokers, queues, delivery acknowledgements, dead-letter queues, and asynchronous processing systems.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Supporting pattern defining controlled asynchronous delivery semantics without implying authorization or business correctness.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines message delivery state and failure handling data as operational signals, not as business trust assertions.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Controls governing system communications, error handling, availability, and fault tolerance (CP, SI, AU families).

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Zero Trust guidance asserting that reliable delivery does not imply authorization or correctness.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Guidance for logging, auditing, and analyzing asynchronous message handling events.

metadata.remarks: Message Queuing defines asynchronous delivery mechanisms that provide reliability and fault isolation. This pattern does not validate message semantics, authorize resulting actions, permit replay beyond bounded delivery windows, or imply downstream business trust.

components.title: Queued Delivery Semantics
components.description: Controlled asynchronous delivery semantics such as at-least-once or at-most-once delivery.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Resource exhaustion or denial via message flooding.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Flow control and delivery semantics limit overload and loss.

implemented-requirements.remarks: System communication mechanisms support resilience and recovery.

components.title: Poison Message Isolation
components.description: Isolation and containment of malformed or harmful messages.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Injection of malformed data to disrupt processing.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Isolation prevents repeated failure and cascading effects.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Error handling prevents system crashes or indefinite failure.

components.title: Dead-Letter Handling
components.description: Explicit handling of messages that fail repeated delivery or processing.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit failure paths prevent silent or unsafe retries.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Processing failures are logged and reviewable.

components.title: Queue Non-Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Explicitly defines what reliable delivery does not grant or imply.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Successful message delivery does not imply authorization or correctness.
